description: This file defines a React component for loading and rendering PayPal buttons with support for subscriptions and one-time payments, including script loading and cleanup logic.

classes.name: PayPalButtonScriptLoader
classes.description: A React component that loads the PayPal SDK script dynamically and renders PayPal buttons with support for subscriptions and one-time payments.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes the component state with incoming props, particularly the isSubscription flag.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads the PayPal SDK script when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes the PayPal SDK script when the component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Reloads the SDK script if relevant props change.

methods.name: loadScript
methods.description: Constructs the SDK script URL and loads it, optionally removing existing scripts.

methods.name: onScriptLoad
methods.description: Callback invoked when the SDK script has loaded successfully.

methods.name: captureOneTimePayment
methods.description: Handles capturing a one-time payment via the PayPal SDK.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the PayPal button component once the SDK is loaded, configuring it for subscription or one-time payment.
